lessons.text: Locate the invoice email in /mail, click into the message, then click the attachment to download it to the drive workspace and use read_file to extract invoice fields.

Resolve the vendor via GET /vendors?q=<vendor name> and match email_domain to sender, then check GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number>; if a bill exists, skip creation and reuse its bill id.
Send confirmation by opening /mail/compose, filling To from the company directory (AP lead), Subject and Message with the existing/created bill id and status, then clicking Send.
The ERP read-only API endpoints are GET /vendors?q= and GET /bills?vendor_id=&invoice_number=; bill records include vendor_id, invoice_number, status, amount, invoice_date, and due_date.
An existing bill with status 'Paid' still counts as a duplicate; do not create a new bill if GET /bills returns a bill for the same vendor and invoice_number, even if already paid.
